will_defaults: I will show up with steadiness for the parenting outcome I chose.
I will practice the behaviors I want my child to learn from me.
will_not: I will not let stress decide the standard of care.
I will not avoid the hard parts of parenting because they are emotionally demanding.
I will not forget that consistency teaches louder than intention.
reality_anchors: Parenting change is built through repetition, repair, and presence.
